footnote_text: Each share of Class B Common Stock is convertible into one share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock at any time, at the election of the holder or automatically upon certain transfers, whether or not for value, or upon the occurrence of certain events or conditions described in the Issuer's Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation.

The reported transaction represents a gift, for no consideration, of shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock, which is exempt from the short-swing profit rule of Section 16 of the Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), pursuant to Rule 16b-5.
